["text", "CHG_INT: U5 BQ25628 ~INT -> U4 IO15 (R-INT-01)
  open drain, 256 us low pulse (SLUSEG4C 8.3.8.3)
  not an LP pin: active and light sleep only
EXP_INT: U17 TCA6408A ~INT -> U4 IO1 (R-V3-02)
  touch P4 + ACC_INT P5, held until read (SCPS192E 8.3.3)
  LP_GPIO1: also wakes the chip from deep sleep
Pull-ups: EXP_INT R61 100K, CONTROLLER pull-up row (R-V3-06)
  CHG_INT: ESP32 internal on GPIO15 (R-INT-03)
NAND CS: U4 IO7, was U17 P2 (R-V3-03)
